allow: PowerShell(Get-Service | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'mysql|maria' -or $_.DisplayName -match 'MySQL|MariaDB' } | Select-Object Name, DisplayName, Status | Format-Table -AutoSize; "---"; $t = Test-NetConnection -ComputerName localhost -Port 3306 -WarningAction SilentlyContinue; "Port 3306 TcpTestSucceeded: $\($t.TcpTestSucceeded\)")
Bash(timeout 50 /bin/bash -c 'until curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:8080/login 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "200"; do sleep 2; done')

Bash(mysql -u root peminjaman_alat_tu -e "SELECT b.id, b.nama_bidang, o.nama_opd, w.nama AS wilayah FROM bidang b JOIN opd o ON b.opd_id=o.id JOIN wilayah w ON o.wilayah_id=w.id WHERE b.nama_bidang LIKE '%Infrastruktur%';")
Bash(mysql -u root peminjaman_alat_tu -e "SELECT * FROM bidang WHERE id=10; SELECT * FROM opd WHERE id IN \(4, 10\); SELECT * FROM wilayah WHERE id IN \(60, 64, 40\);")

PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { try { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {} }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object OwningProcess)
